# whats360.live
> whats360.live is a WhatsApp Business platform: shared team inbox, CRM, bulk campaigns, AI bot, REST API and webhooks. Official site: https://whats360.live

## Developer docs (GitHub)
- [API reference](https://github.com/whats360-api/whats360-api-docs/blob/main/api-reference.md): authentication, send messages, devices, campaigns, errors
- [OpenAPI draft](https://github.com/whats360-api/whats360-api-docs/blob/main/openapi.yaml): endpoints from the official reference; gaps marked
- [Webhooks guide](https://github.com/whats360-api/whats360-webhooks/blob/main/webhooks-guide.md): events, payload fields, Shopify, WooCommerce, n8n, custom
- [Node.js client](https://github.com/whats360-api/whats360-nodejs-sdk)
- [PHP client](https://github.com/whats360-api/whats360-php-sdk)
- [Postman collection](https://github.com/whats360-api/whats360-postman-collection)

## Facts
- API base URL: https://whats360.live/api/v1
- Auth: `token` query parameter (invalid or expired returns 401); most calls also need `instance_id` (device ID).
- Credentials are account-private. Never place real tokens in code or repos.
